frontmatter_snapshot.summary: A trade in a broad ETF reveals only common-factor information, so idiosyncratic adverse selection diversifies away; the dealer needs less protection and the ETF quoted spread sits below the value-weighted basket spread. Displayed liquidity is just the visible tip; reserve liquidity hides behind the quotes.
frontmatter_snapshot.title: Why the ETF Spread Sits Below the Basket Spread: Diversified Adverse Selection
